title: Tara Ceranic Salinas, PhD (Professor of Business Ethics · Lead Editor, Journal of Business Ethics Education) — 'Hands down the best business book I've ever read'
summary: Tara Ceranic Salinas, PhD — Professor of Business Ethics at University of San Diego Knauss School of Business; Lead Editor of the Journal of Business Ethics Education — endorses Incorruptible in the strongest possible terms and adds it to her required reading for the MBA Ethics, Values, and Corporate Culture course. Already using material from the book in Business & Society and her new Wellbeing, Work and You class.
blockquote: Hands down the best business book I've ever read: Incorruptible by Eric Ries. I finished listening to the audiobook and immediately bought the hardcover just so I could re-read, mark it up, and make sure I didn't miss anything. I can't recommend it enough! It moves ethics from vague values to concrete, operational strategy and addresses how to protect your organization's culture and mission when real stakes and trade-offs are on the line. Essential for anyone trying to navigate business (or life) with long-term integrity.
blockquote_source: Tara Ceranic Salinas, PhD on LinkedIn
